blurb: Guests can visit multiple retail locations in Nova Scotia to sample and purchase Coldstream's products including spirits, liqueurs, iced teas, lemonades, vodka sodas, gin sodas, and beers. The distillery offers on-site and off-site bar services for private events, customizing menus and handling event bar details. Their product line includes canned cocktails, rum cream, and lagers, with a focus on true taste and community.
